cause_claim: The change adds rule-0291 for template T4 with criteria f01 and f13. Contract ic-0006 specifies inputs_supplied=12 for content-interpreter.load_rules. Candidate experiment (x-0a62a89848144148) shows exit_code=3 with fatal error: "rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)". The rule references f13 which maps to the 13th input slot, but only 12 slots are supplied (f01-f12). The fix is to remove f13 from rule-0291's criteria. Baseline experiment (x-f4b9e164c6374d16) with 3 rules having 2-3 fields each and exit_code=0 confirms the interpreter works when rules stay within 12 input slots.
